ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a predominantly high-intensity white/light-grey interior surface (>80% of surface area) bounded by low-intensity black margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black perimeter banding along the entire trailing edge. High-density cluster of dark irregular spots localized in the outer quadrant of the right lobe. Isolated low-intensity pixels scattered across the left lobe's medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped vertex approximately 135 degrees with a vertical depth of roughly 15% relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing boundary, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the outer lateral thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in jagged, encrusted lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately 8-12 high-contrast dark circular and semi-circular spots on the right lobe. Irregular, textured calcified masses visible at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical low-intensity linear marks extending approximately 5-10% of the lobe width, visible on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcification and biological growth (likely barnacles) present on the lateral tips of both lobes, creating an irregular, jagged silhouette distinct from the pigment-based markers.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric pigmentation where the right lobe exhibits significantly higher focal spotting compared to the relatively clean left lobe.
